'''Erich Weiss''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[The Witch House]] or, when combining [[Miskatonic Horror]] with [[Innsmouth Horror]], at the [[Devil Reef]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Evade]]

You cannot be [[delay]]ed.
